name: Meimei
source:
[i]"But my ex was like, ugh, this coconut isn't authentic. Like any of us know what the real thing tastes like, right?"[/i]

[i]Lovesick Darling[/i]

One of the heroine's few friends. She's bubbling, charming, and as sweet as sugar. Her major flaw is that he tends to get too attached to her boyfriends. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
